name: Magical Letterbox
description:
The Magical Letterbox is a post box that, when supplied with a coin, summons a Courier to carry letters placed within it.
Bronn Boromir used the Letterbox to send a message to his uncle Bogo Boromir by inserting a gold coin. A Courier appeared, retrieved the party's earlier undelivered parcels and loose acorns, took Bronn's new letter, and departed down the mountain carrying all the items.
